title: DistillationRun.v1
description: One execution of ANY Baltor transform (ingest/decompose/reconcile/optimize/promote/LLM-to-rule). The lossless-distillation law's per-transform record: it pins which input artifacts (by id + hash) were consumed, which output artifacts (by id + hash) were produced, the transform identity + config that produced them, the full lineage bundle, the receipts, and — critically — the three preservation lists (omitted/held_out/rejected) which MUST be present even when empty so 'omitted ≠ deleted' is auditable, plus a rollback target. Distillation is never replacement: the inputs are referenced, never overwritten. Content-addressed + deterministic when created_at is injected. A run carries EITHER config_hash (deterministic processor/pipeline config) OR rule_version (LLM-to-rule conversion) — that disjunction is enforced by check_lossless_distillation_contracts, not expressible in the stdlib validator keyword set.

run_id.description: content-addressed run id (sha256 over inputs+transform+config, deterministic)

source_scope.description: lineage scope; a tenant_private run must never be referenced from a global_public lineage

input_artifact_ids.description: the artifacts consumed; never overwritten by this run

input_hashes.description: content hash of each input (parallel to input_artifact_ids); pins the exact bytes consumed

output_artifact_ids.description: the NEW derived artifacts produced; a derived layer, not a replacement

output_hashes.description: content hash of each output (parallel to output_artifact_ids)

transform_type.description: the kind of transform this run performed

processor_id.description: deterministic processor that ran (if transform_type is processor-driven)

config_hash.description: hash of the transform config; present for deterministic transforms. Either this OR rule_version must be present (check enforces).

prompt_hash.description: hash of the prompt, when an LLM produced the output

rule_id.description: the deterministic rule, for an LLM-to-rule conversion

rule_version.description: rule version; present for llm_to_rule transforms. Either this OR config_hash must be present (check enforces).

lineage.description: the embedded lineage bundle: how each output reaches its raw/source. Conforms to LineageBundle.v1's core shape.

receipts.description: receipt ids that warrant this run (verification/promotion/etc.); proof handles, never erased

omitted_artifact_ids.description: artifacts excluded from the served view by this transform — HELD OUT, not deleted; MUST be present even if empty

held_out_artifact_ids.description: artifacts deliberately held out (e.g. allegations, FAQ-30) — rehydratable, not forgotten; MUST be present even if empty

rejected_candidate_ids.description: candidate outputs that lost to the promoted one — preserved with lineage to the winner; MUST be present even if empty

rollback_target_id.description: the artifact/version the active pointer reverts to if this run's output is rolled back; moving the pointer never deletes this run's output

created_at.description: injected time; the run is deterministic when this is injected
